metadata.title: Agentic Behavior Governance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for constraining and governing autonomous and semi-autonomous behavior of agentic AI systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Agentic artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, tool-using AI, and goal-directed AI systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how autonomous and semi-autonomous AI behavior is authorized, bounded, monitored, and overridden.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides adversary-centric context for execution, persistence, and impact techniques leveraged through agentic AI systems.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-native threat taxonomy for autonomous agent abuse, goal hijacking, and unintended action execution.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats arising from AI agents acting beyond approved scope or humans deferring too much authority to agentic systems.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where agent goals are manipulated via prompts, context, or tool feedback to cause harmful or unauthorized actions.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats involving unauthorized or unsafe use of external tools, APIs, file systems, or network actions by AI agents.

metadata.remarks: Agentic Behavior Governance defines how AI systems capable of autonomous or semi-autonomous action are explicitly authorized, constrained, and supervised. This pattern exists to address AI-native risks associated with autonomy, delegation, tool use, and goal-driven behavior that cannot be mitigated by traditional access control or inference protection alone.

components.title: Agent Action Authorization
components.description: Explicit authorization of which actions an AI agent is permitted to take autonomously.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Autonomous AI agents are restricted to a defined and approved set of actions aligned to their intended role.

components.title: Tool Use and Sandboxing
components.description: Restriction and isolation of external tools and environments accessible to AI agents.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI agent tool usage is constrained to sandboxed environments that limit blast radius and unintended side effects.

components.title: Human Oversight Checkpoints
components.description: Mandatory human approval points for sensitive, high-impact, or escalating agent actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Autonomous agent workflows include defined human-in-the-loop checkpoints for high-risk or irreversible actions.
